Use case: illustration-story. One complete literary-room companion mother artwork, exactly 1536 × 1024 pixels, horizontal canvas. There are two image inputs, with distinct authority: IMAGE 1 is the primary-approved EMPTY literary room and is the sole authority for the room, camera, furniture and clear-day atmosphere. IMAGE 2 is this same character's newly approved literary-room CHAT mother, used ONLY for her correct identity, school clothing, linework and near-camera human scale. Do not carry over its seated body, gesture, held booklet or activity. Build the entire body anew for the requested situation. No old room4 image, different character image or anatomical silhouette is supplied.

Keep the exact close room camera and mild perspective of IMAGE 1. Preserve its complete large wood window, autumn lake-town and mountain view, ivory curtains, left wood writing desk and original wooden chair, shelves/books/frames/plants, round side table and its blue-white porcelain lamp/cup/books/flowers, long wood window bench with linen cushion, blue-gray plaid pillows and knit throw at right, wood floor, woven rug and softly blurred foreground plant. The view is a fictional illustrated literary room, not a claimed actual location. One person only. No new desk, extra chair, moved window, zoom, crop, room redesign, second person or extra off-camera hands. Existing lamp and cup stay on their original table.

文学瞬间：听见漂亮句子背后的停顿。
心理：她读到一段说得很体面的告别，真正留住她的却是动作里没有跟上的那一点。她有自己的读法，也愿意听另一种解释。 善于顾及措辞的人，反而会被不够圆满的真心打动。 明亮的页里，那句礼貌的告别显得更值得细想。
目光：停在页内的留白，随后望向同伴，像在试问自己是不是读深了一点。 书页到同伴，短短确认一次。
相处：分享一层含蓄的理解，给对方重新解释人物的自由。 提出自己的读法，等对方指出另一种可能。
表情：眼神略有疑问，唇线安静，情绪留在细小的停顿里。 唇角几乎要笑，又停在疑问。
光线：日光照书口和发边，纸页不泛成一整块金色。

Character: Soyo Nagasaki / 長崎そよ, BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!!. Keep the youthful identifiable anime face and ordinary student proportions of her approved input: long LIGHT BROWN hair with softly curved side locks and gently curled ends, airy fine bangs, clear BLUE eyes and an observant delicate youthful face. Both eyes and bangs remain clearly drawn and visible. Faithful Tsukinomori uniform: dark NAVY sailor blouse with broad WHITE collar and fine navy trim, gray-blue bow with small GOLD school crest at throat, dark navy pleated knee-length skirt with TWO white hem lines, dark knee socks and BROWN loafers. Preserve these own colors under the light. No blonde/pink/blue borrowed hair, mature model styling or chibi proportions. Modest fully clothed school-day companionship.

New READING pose and real support: sit on the actual right-hand linen window bench in front of the plaid pillows. A plain open book and a simple unlettered bookmark are held by both hands and supported by her lap. One hand pauses at the page corner without actually completing a page turn. She has gently lifted her blue eyes from a white space on the page toward the off-camera companion, as though offering her own tentative reading of an elegant but incomplete farewell. Her lips almost form a smile, but remain in a thoughtful small question. The book stays below her face; shoulders and seated spine are natural, not a display pose. Her pelvis/thighs settle with weight on the cushion; each knee, lower leg and complete brown shoe is clearly connected and separately readable, feet resting naturally on the floor. Basic comfortable legs with a small natural stagger allowed, no overlapping one knee over the other while both feet pretend to lie parallel flat. The bookmark has no readable quote. Real book/hand/cushion/shoe contacts.

Scale, anatomy and finish: keep the newly approved close-camera human scale of this same character. A bench pose can have hair top around y=110 and shoes around y=850–900, with the precise shoe depth following the real seat position; the desk pose must follow its real chair and floor perspective rather than mechanically copy bench coordinates. Never enlarge the head, lean the face toward the lens, elongate shins or shrink furniture to force a number. Keep the entire hair, hands, knees, ankles and BOTH complete shoes in frame. Basic joints and the two legs must read continuously and independently; hands have coherent fingers and wrists, no fused limbs, no furniture penetration. Natural soft local contact shadows and honest occlusion. Subtle almond-gold clear-day window light, distinct local hair/skin/clothing colors, clear gentle facial shadow planes, natural white paper and ivory fabric. Refined anime linework and soft anime shading integrated with the detailed literary room, no sticker edge, gray/gold overlay or new colored spotlight. Book/paper marks are faint abstract texture only: no readable quotes, names, dates, calendar, completed task or schedule. No UI, sleep icons, speech, caption, logo, watermark, border, collage or artificial fog.
